tagline: Paste a link. Get the file.

presetHints.mp3: Audio only, MP3 with cover art

queueEmpty: Nothing here yet. Paste a YouTube link above, or use the browser extension.

errors.age: This video is age-restricted. Pick a browser where you're signed in to YouTube.
errors.bot: YouTube is blocking requests from your IP address and asks to sign in. Pick a browser where you're signed in to YouTube and the app will use its cookies. A VPN also helps.
errors.members: This video is for channel members. Pick a browser where you're signed in with a member account.
errors.network: Network problem. Check your connection and try again.
errors.engine: The download engine couldn't start. Try reinstalling it in Settings.
errors.invalid-url: That doesn't look like a link.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Updating the engine in Settings often fixes it.
errors.botWithCookies: YouTube still asks to sign in, even with cookies from {browser}. Make sure you're signed in to YouTube there, or turn on a VPN or set a proxy in Settings.
errors.cookies-locked: {browser} keeps its cookies locked while it's running. Quit {browser} completely and retry, or pick another browser.
errors.cookies-decrypt: On Windows, {browser} encrypts cookies so they can't be read. Pick Firefox instead.
errors.cookies-permission: No access to Safari cookies. Allow "Full Disk Access" for the app in System Settings → Privacy & Security, or pick another browser.
errors.cookies-missing: No cookies found in {browser}. Pick another browser.

settings.title: Settings
settings.engineHint: yt-dlp updates itself daily. If downloads start failing, update it manually.
settings.extensionHint: Adds a Download button right on YouTube.
settings.cookiesHint: Used when YouTube asks to sign in or confirm you're not a bot. Pick a browser where you're signed in to YouTube. Cookies never leave your computer.
settings.proxySystem: Using the system proxy {proxy}. Enter another address to override it.
settings.proxyNone: No system proxy found. If YouTube only opens through a VPN or proxy app, enter its address, e.g. socks5://127.0.0.1:1080.
settings.proxyInvalid: Use a full address like http://host:port or socks5://host:port.

firstRun.title: Setting things up
firstRun.text: Downloading the tools that do the heavy lifting. This happens once and takes about a minute.
firstRun.failed: Couldn't download the tools. Check your internet connection.

noBrowsers: No supported browser found. Sign in to YouTube in Chrome or Firefox, or turn on a VPN.
